thread:
Nina (CSE): ACME reports bursts of 429 on iOS during rollout, plus a couple 401s on token refresh. Happens only in first ~10m.
ACME Eng: we call init on cold start and when opening chat; tokens rotate every 5m.
Jun (Support): likely a startup stampede + short TTL overlap. Are you debouncing init?
ACME Eng: no, each screen triggers init.
Omar (Eng): quick fixes: upgrade to SDK that adds init singleflight/debounce and set a short client debounce (e.g., 3s). Infra can also apply a temporary warmup bypass or short quota bump for onboarding.
Nina (CSE): which SDK?
Jun (Support): use 0.9.3 which reuses in-flight init and exposes initDebounceMs. Recommend initDebounceMs=3000 and increase token TTL to >=2m during the ramp.
Omar (Eng): I'll open an infra ticket for account 34721 and ask SRE to approve a temporary bump.
deploy-bot: Created infra/issue-#2481  warmup-bypass request for acct 34721. Canary window proposed.
Liz (CSM): ACME will upgrade tonight and run a stepped ramp (10 -> 100 -> 1k). I'll coordinate a support window and ask them to capture x-rate-limit-* headers.
Nina (CSE): sending upgrade + config snippet and will monitor results after their ramp. Thanks everyone.
